newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan Taleban names new foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Afghan Taleban names new foreign minister.

text.p: The government of the Taleban Islamic movement in Afghanistan named a new foreign minister, Mullah Abdul Jalil, on Friday to replace Mullah Mohammad Ghous, who taken prisoner by opposition forces late last month.
Official Kabul radio, monitored in Islamabad, said Taleban leader Mullah Mohammad Omar ordered the appointment of Jalil, previously a deputy foreign minister.
Ghous was captured by local ethnic Uzbek forces in the northern city of Mazar-i-Sharif when they drove out Taleban fighters after a brief alliance between the two sides.
Also seized were Afghan central bank chief Mullah Ahsanullah and northern Taleban commander Mullah Abdul Razzaq. Nothing has since become known about the fate of the three men.
